title: Scale and Selection: What Makes Automatic Harness Evolution Work for Visual-Interface Robot Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.39304v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When an off-the-shelf coding agent is used directly as a robot policy, observing a browser-based 3D interface through screenshots and acting by posing a virtual target gripper through a few tools, the agent's harness, its prompts, tools, and control rules, largely determines success, and until now it has been written by hand. We show that this harness can be improved automatically by another coding agent, the optimizer agent, and report two findings about what makes it work. First, the number of rollouts the optimizer agent sees per round governs whether the evolved harness is trustworthy, generalizes, and improves steadily. A single rollout is a noisy binary outcome, so with few rollouts per round a revision can be promoted on luck; enlarging the batch raises the signal-to-noise ratio of every promotion decision. translated_title: 规模与选择：究竟是什么让自动执行框架演化对视觉界面机器人智能体奏效
translated_abstract: 当一个现成的编码智能体被直接用作机器人策略时——即通过截图观察基于浏览器的3D界面，并通过少量工具操纵虚拟目标夹爪来执行动作——智能体的执行框架（harness，即其提示词、工具和控制规则）在很大程度上决定了成败，而迄今为止该框架一直依靠人工编写。我们证明这一执行框架可以由另一个编码智能体（即优化智能体）自动改进，并报告了两项关于其为何有效的发现。首先，优化智能体每轮所看到的 rollout（轨迹运行）数量，决定了演化出的框架是否可信、能否泛化并持续稳定提升。单个 rollout 是一个带噪声的二元结果，因此每轮 rollout 数量很少时，某次修改可能仅凭运气就被采纳；扩大批次规模可以提升每次采纳决策的信噪比。在保持轮数不变的情况下，将训练集从 5 个 rollout 扩大到 100 个 rollout，留出集成功率从 47% 提升至 67%（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究表明，用另一个编码智能体自动优化机器人智能体的执行框架（提示词、工具与控制规则）时，每轮参与评估的训练 rollout 数量是成败关键——将其从 5 个扩大到 100 个，可通过提升每次采纳决策的信噪比，把留出集成功率从 47% 提高到 67%。
en_tdlr: When a coding agent automatically evolves another robot agent's harness (prompts, tools, and control rules), the number of training rollouts per round is the key factor: scaling from 5 to 100 rollouts raises held-out success from 47% to 67% by increasing the signal-to-noise ratio of each promotion decision.
